fields.Scholarship Location/Information: Barbara Mansfield Champion Scholar Award | TLBR
fields.Name of Scholarship: The Barbara Mansfield Champion Scholar Award (The Last Best Ride)
fields.Summary: The Barbara Mansfield Champion Scholar Award is designated for financially qualified women from towns in the Flathead Valley pursuing post-secondary education. A minimum of two, $2,500 scholarships are awarded each year. We strongly encourage women who identify as Black, Indigenous or as a woman of color to apply for this scholarship. Scholar award funds are disbursed directly to the educational institution the scholar plans to attend and are intended to help cover costs of tuition, books, room and board, and instructional supplies.

2 x $1,000 scholarships available. Due by March 30, 2026. Eligibility: Open to Whitefish High School graduating seniors who are interested in advancing their education by attending a 4-year, 2-year, technical or vocational school. Please submit volunteer service in resume form including dates, location, supervisor contact information, description of volunteer service, etc. Please submit TWO short essays (see application form).

fields.Scholarship Location/Information: Gianforte Trade and Tech Scholarship Fact Sheet
fields.Summary: A Montana state scholarship of $1,500 per semester (full-time; $750 part-time, renewable up to $6,000) for Montana residents enrolled at least half-time in a qualifying trade or technical program — automotive, plumbing, electrical, construction, diesel, cybersecurity, and more. File the FAFSA and demonstrate unmet financial need. You apply once you are enrolled in the program (fall and spring deadlines).

Diversity Scholarship Application; expand the perspectives shared and voices heard. Preference to underrepresented groups. Essay topic of 300 words: "What is the importance of diversity and inclusion?"  Water & Environmental Technologies, Inc. (WET) is a technical environmental and engineering consulting firm committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We believe innovation and creativity come when companies advocate for a varied range of experience, talent, and ideas. To continue our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we are offering a scholarship for first year college students who share our passion and vision to expand the perspectives shared and voices heard. WET will award two (2) $1,000 scholarships. This scholarship is open to Montana and Wyoming High School students, but preference will be given to those who are members of an underrepresented class* (i.e. include, but are not limited to, the following: ethnicity, disability, gender, sexual orientation, income, education, etc.) Paper Application and all required attachments should be submitted to: WATER & ENVIRONMENTAL TECHNOLOGIES   ATTENTION: DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION COMMITTEE   480 EAST PARK STREET    BUTTE, MT 59701  or Applications can also be submitted on our website at the following link:  waterenvtech.com/diversityscholarship

The purpose of the scholarship is to provide financial assistance to students who are graduates of a Flathead County high school and those currently attending Flathead Valley Community College who wish to pursue higher education or vocational training.  Other criteria are:  a traditional or non-traditional student who already has or is currently completing requirements for a high school diploma or G.E.D.; an individual able to demonstrate financial need; and one who is learning the philosophy of the Democratic Party and continuing their education. The student is asked to include an essay stating the reasons for applying, their educational or vocational goals, community service activities, employment history and extracurricular activities. Paper applications to be mailed to: Flathead County Democratic Women     c/o Linda Harris    853 Highland Loop   Whitesh, MT 59937  (for additional information, call Linda Harris 406-261-4790)

fields.Name of Scholarship: Whitefish Soroptimist Memorial Scholarship for Girls Graduating High School
fields.Summary: Eligible students: Senior girls in Flathead County Public High Schools in 2025 who are planning to attend college or university. Criteria: financial need, academic ability, and those seeking a career that aligns with the mission of Soroptimist International. Our mission statement is "A global volunteer organization that provides women and girls with access to the education and training they need to achieve economic empowerment." Priority given to girls planning to attend in-state programs (but it is NOT a requirement!).

Paper applications to be dropped off in person, or mailed to: Officer Reece Stahlberg c/o Whitefish Police Department 275 Flathead Ave. Whitefish, MT 59937

Please do not send word files, google doc links or multiple files.

rows.source_name: Montana Association of Conservation District's  2024 Natural Resources Scholarship (2 - $1,000)

fields.Name of Scholarship: Montana Association of Conservation District's  2024 Natural Resources Scholarship (2 - $1,000)
fields.Summary: Must be a US citizen with Montana residency or attending an educational institution within the state of Montana; enrolled in or planning to pursue a course of study related to Montana’s natural resources. Appropriate courses of study include agriculture, agribusiness, animal science, range science, forestry, environmental science, land resource science, plant science, etc. 4 short essay questions are asked about your education, experiences, and how your course of study will allow you to have an impact on Montana’s natural resource issues in the future. Letters of recommendation, transcript, and acceptance letters (to school) are required. Contact Madi Larson at madi@macdnet.org or 406-443-5711 with questions.

fields.Summary: Your parents do NOT need to be a member of the Whitefish Classified Employees to apply; application essays are reviewed and ranked on your thoughts for your goals and plans for higher education and any special considerations as to why you should receive this scholarship. rows.source_name: Flathead Electric Basin and MECA Scholarship (2 scholarships, 1 application!)

fields.Name of Scholarship: Flathead Electric Basin and MECA Scholarship (2 scholarships, 1 application!)
fields.Summary: By completing this application, you will be considered for both scholarships. Applicant or parent/guardian must be a member of Flathead Electric Cooperative. No minimums given, but applicants will be judged on: 20% Academic Strength (as demonstrated by rigors of coursework, GPA and national testing scores), 20% Activities in School and Community, Awards & Honors, 20% Employment, Volunteerism, and Community Service and 40% Personal Statement (“Write about how your school/community/work activities will influence your goals and career choice. (600 word limit)”)
